violations.description: General equipment and utensils - Materials and design. — --Material of food contact surface * was not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent and cleanable. - Cutting board on the food prep table has deep cuts and scratches in it.

Clean-in-place (CIP) equipment - Design and construction. — --Food contact surface of clean in place equipment * was not cleaned properly. - Cutting board on the food prep table not clean.--Nonfood contact surface of clean in place equipment * was not cleaned properly. - Clean in place equipment not clean. Cabinet faces, handles, and under equipment require a thorough cleaning.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…)* were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. - Floor in around the sink and cooking area dirty.

Date marking and disposition of ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food. — --Refrigerated, ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food * (prepared more than 24 hours ago) was not properly date marked. - Dates not put on RTE food in the walk-in cooler.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface * was not cleaned as frequently as required. - Clean in place equipment and in and around equipment needs more frequent cleaning.--Ventilation hood system was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required. - Vent hood filters need cleaned.
